description: Sidewalks is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. This data set includes all sidewalks and curb ramps on the roads system under the jurisdiction of NYSDOT. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are sidewalks, pedestrian network, curb ramps, american with disabilities act, ada. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2014-11-19 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
